A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same T2SG/TopoFormer study and provide readable methods, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither contains an appendix; v1 mentions supplementary material that is not included in either supplied PDF.

before.justification: Tables 1–3 report original TopoFormer evaluations and component ablations, and Figure 3 presents qualitative predictions.

after.justification: V2 retains the original quantitative experiments, component ablations, and qualitative results in Tables 1–3 and Figure 3.

M1.justification: The detector, LAL/CIL components, edge head, losses, and inference procedure remain unchanged. V2 newly describes detector pretraining, but v1 does not specify the initialization sequence, so this does not establish a revised method.

E1.justification: Both retain the OpenLane-V2-derived T2SG task with ten lane categories and traffic-topology evaluation on subsets A and B. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 2 retain their respective comparator sets, including TopoMLP only on subset A. The newly cited Topo2Seq work does not appear in the reported comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.2 changes the reported BEV grid from 200×200 to 200×100. This is a limited configuration revision; the PDFs do not establish whether experiments were rerun. The newly disclosed detector-pretraining sequence is additional documentation.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same LAL aggregation and CIL intervention ablations. Figure 3 preserves the same straight-road and intersection examples, with no additional robustness or error analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical tests. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: All reported values in Tables 1–3 remain unchanged, including TopoFormer OLS scores of 46.3 on subset A and 47.5 on subset B. Figure 3 also retains the same qualitative predictions.

T1.justification: The formal graph definition and Equations (1)–(17), including attention, counterfactual effects, losses, and connectivity, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, proofs, or derivations are added or removed.

C1.justification: Both claim a unified traffic topology scene graph, the LAL/CIL-based TopoFormer, and superior T2SG and downstream topology performance. Splitting CIL into a separate contribution bullet in v2 does not introduce a new scientific claim.

C2.justification: The explanations involving global lane information, counterfactual road structure, zero-versus-mean/random interventions, and subset B generalization are retained. The warning about inaccurate centerlines remains, with no substantive limitation added or removed.

D1.justification: V1 promises future code/model release; v2 provides a source-code repository link. Section 4.2 newly documents training the lane detector before the T2SG task and revises the BEV grid specification. V2 also removes pointers to supplementary details absent from both PDFs.

R1.justification: Literature coverage is substantially revised: v2 removes much of the cited 3D scene-graph and counterfactual literature, adds Topo2Seq and several scene-graph, retrieval, and prediction papers, and replaces Pearl with Rao et al. as the citation motivating counterfactual intervention. The main novelty position remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Section 2 is condensed and rewritten, topology-results prose is tightened, and three contribution bullets become four. Author emails and a funding acknowledgment are added, while the main technical narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 3 are scaled down, captions and float spacing are adjusted, and text and references reflow. Page numbers are removed. The same three figures and three tables remain, with unchanged visual evidence.

improvement.justification: V2 improves reproducibility documentation by providing a code location and explaining detector pretraining that v1 leaves unspecified. Literature coverage is narrower, and the BEV-grid revision is unexplained despite unchanged results. The concrete documentation gains support a limited overall improvement; empirical validation remains unchanged.
